subject: volcano
name: 火山
label: 有层次的火山
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One volcano in three-quarter landscape view, broad crater rim, two large lava channels, simple rock slope divisions and three connected billowing smoke masses.
A self-contained vignette wholly within 12 percent margins. Draw the described forms only, with spacious smooth contours and at most a few structural details. No added pebbles, grass, sand stippling, rough sketch repetitions or dense surface patterns.
